name: Photon Mapping for Participating Media
definition: A method for non-homogeneous materials extending photon mapping to participating media. It uses Monte Carlo simulation of photon transport from light sources, accounting for spatially varying optical properties and general phase functions.
summary: Photon Mapping for Participating Media is a global illumination algorithm that extends surface-based photon mapping to accurately render complex lighting effects like caustics in volumetric media by decoupling light transport simulation from final image synthesis.
